---
applyTo: "**"
---

For PR creation, default base branch is `develop`. Assign the PR to yourself
with `--assignee @me`. If reviewers are not specified, ask for at least one and
list likely repo contributors. Use only labels that exist in `gh label list`.

For PR review, support local review, direct GitHub review, inline comments,
approve, comment, and request-changes. Verify submitted review feedback before
implementing fixes.
